title_zh: 澄清住房援助表格栏目并索取材料清单

scenario.label_zh: 澄清住房援助申请的信息要求
scenario.goal_zh: 向接待员确认家庭成员与不固定收入的填写方法，并索取材料清单后再完成申请

context_zh: 来访者在一家虚构的住房援助服务处询问申请表，不涉及现实资格判断。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: I'm homeless at the moment and staying with a friend. Can I ask about this housing form?

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: Of course. Which part is unclear?

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: It asks for everyone in my household. Do I include the friend I'm staying with?

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: For this form, list the people who would move into the new home with you. We record temporary hosts separately.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: And my income changes each week because my working hours vary.

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: The adviser will need the recent records listed on this sheet. You don't have to invent a fixed weekly figure.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: Could I take the sheet and bring the records back before I finish the form?

sentences.speaker: Chris
sentences.text: Yes. I'll mark the two sections we discussed so the adviser can go through them with you.

targets.sense_zh: 共同居住的家庭成员群体
